name: Anime Character Workflow
description: 二次元角色生成标准 Workflow，基于 NovelAI/Anything 模型

inputs.text:
masterpiece, best quality, high quality, ultra detailed, absurdres
anime style, colorful, detailed background
1girl, solo, full body, standing
blonde hair, long hair, wavy hair, twintails
blue eyes, beautiful detailed eyes
smile, blush
white shirt, black skirt, red ribbon
outdoors, cherry blossoms, blue sky, school
sunlight, wind, soft lighting, from below

worst quality, low quality, normal quality
bad anatomy, bad hands, bad proportions
extra digits, fewer digits, missing fingers

deformed, disfigured, mutated
blurry, out of focus, lowres
text, watermark, signature, username
cropped, worst feet, extra ears

en.title: Anime Character Generation Workflow
steps: 1. Replace 'put_your_model_here.safetensors' with your NovelAI/Anything model path
2. Replace 'put_your_lora_here.safetensors' with your character LoRA path
3. Modify the positive prompt to match your character description
4. Adjust LoRA strength_model (0.5-0.8 recommended for characters)
5. Set your desired seed or leave at 0 for random
tips: For more detail, increase steps to 35
For more creativity, increase CFG to 9
For stronger character resemblance, increase LoRA weight
For more variation, change the seed

zh.title: 二次元角色生成 Workflow
steps: 1. 将 'put_your_model_here.safetensors' 替换为你的 NovelAI/Anything 模型路径
2. 将 'put_your_lora_here.safetensors' 替换为你的角色 LoRA 路径
3. 修改正向提示词以匹配你的角色描述
5. 设置你想要的种子，或留 0 随机
tips: 想要更多细节？将步数增加到 35
想要更有创意？将 CFG 增加到 9
想要角色更像？增加 LoRA 权重
想要更多变化？换一个种子
